definition: Completed successful runs / completed success-or-failure runs; queued/cancelled runs excluded.
First completed attempt per workflow run; skipped/neutral/cancelled excluded, missing denominator unknown.

Observed confirmed review submissions: approvals, change requests, or authenticated linked inline comments. Body-only and ambiguous submissions remain unclassified; consult agentic_review_unclassified_total. Delivery completeness and historical reconciliation remain unverified.
Verified issue creation to first associated merged PR; incomplete mappings excluded and reported separately.
Reported tokens only; cached-input breakdown must not be charged twice.
Reported tokens only; absent model usage is unknown.
Reconciled actual charges only; partial where unknown-cost runs exist. No estimated price substitution.
Runs lacking reconciled actual cost; zero is meaningful only when the producer explicitly reports complete coverage.
Distinct explicit needs-human incidents, deduplicated across retries.
Owner-confirmed post-release defects linked to deployment; no automatic inference from every Sentry event.
Billing-source actual month-to-date value; delayed and potentially incomplete until invoice reconciliation. Cross-repository total is partial when any selected source is missing.
Provider-reported usage charges, not an estimate from span counts. Cross-repository total is partial when any selected source is missing.
Age of oldest actionable pending run, excluding intentionally disabled work; unavailable producer is unknown.
Terminal failed deployments, unique by deployment ID/environment.

Latest durable receipt minus source timestamp, maximum across observed repository/source measurements. Invalid timing is omitted; inspect agentic_source_timing_valid and agentic_source_receipt_age_seconds separately. A quick last delivery does not prove a quiet source is fresh or complete.
